summary: Pedestrian geometry of Zurich HB for hack #1 (get off at 'Zürich, Central', run over the Bahnhofbrücke). All coordinates are OSM nodes returned by Overpass (2026-09-13). Central tram stop (OSM ref 619) has platforms A-H; trams toward HB leave from F (4, 11, 15 -> Bahnhofstrasse/HB), H (6, 7, 10 -> Bahnhofplatz/HB or Bahnhofstrasse/HB) and B (3 -> Bahnhofplatz/HB); the Polybahn lower station is node 29542965 (47.376518, 8.544172). CRITICAL CURRENT-STATE FINDING: the tram stop 'Bahnhofquai/HB' (OSM ref 413, nodes 2264870172/29271923 at 47.37766, 8.54174) is out of service for track reconstruction until mid-December 2026 (SBB Innenplan 12/2025: 'Gleisbau und Sanierung Tramhaltestelle Bahnhofquai/HB bis Mitte Dezember 2026'; live stationboard 2026-09-13 shows only bus 46; no tram route relation in OSM stops there). Trams from Central therefore run non-stop over the Bahnhofbrücke to Bahnhofplatz/HB (3, 6, 10, 14; 2 min scheduled) or Bahnhofstrasse/HB (4, 7, 10, 11, 13, 15; 2-3 min). The underground ShopVille accesses at the Bahnhofquai/HB stop are also closed until mid-Dec 2026. PLATFORM NUMBERING CORRECTION: 3-18 = surface terminus platforms (420 m, level 0, Kopfbahnhof; Querhalle 108x24 m at the EAST head, Haupthalle 131x43 m east of it, east portal on the Bahnhofquai facade); 21-22 = SZU (Uetliberg/Sihltal, 125 m platform, 11.6 m below street, under Bahnhofplatz/south facade); 31-34 = Bahnhof Löwenstrasse (through tracks, 420 m, 15.4 m deep, OSM level -4); 41-44 = Bahnhof Museumstrasse (through tracks, 360 m, 13.6 m deep, OSM level -3; renumbered from 21-24 in May 2012). The task premise (21-24 Museumstrasse, 41-44 SZU) is outdated. DISTANCES (haversine chains over OSM nodes; indoor Haupthalle leg is straight-line because OSM has no routable ways inside the hall): Central platform F -> Bahnhofquai/HB stop 187 m; -> Haupthalle east portal 217 m; -> head of platform 3/10-11/18: 402/382/390 m with ZERO level changes; -> Museumstrasse 41-44: 424 m (2 escalator descents, mid-platform) or 438 m via the NE-corner Landesmuseum stairs (3 short flights, lands 72 m from the platforms' east end); -> Löwenstrasse 31-34: 423 m (2 descents); -> SZU 21-22: ~423 m (2 descents, low confidence). From the (closed) Bahnhofquai/HB stop subtract 187 m (e.g. 195 m to head of platform 10/11). From Bahnhofplatz/HB: 40-85 m to head of platform 3, 110-150 m to 10/11, 175-215 m to 18 (level 0); 64 m to SZU; 199 m to 31-34; 244 m to 41-44. From Sihlquai/HB: 100 m to the WEST end of 41-44 (2 descents), 205 m to 31-34, 114 m onto platform 10/11 at ~210 m from the head (via Passage Sihlquai), 237 m along platform 18 to its head. SBB planner (transport.opendata.ch, queried 2026-09-13 for 2026-09-14 08:05) gives walks Central->Zürich HB 4 min, Bahnhofplatz/HB->HB 1 min, Bahnhofstrasse/HB->HB 2 min, Sihlquai/HB->HB 1 min, Central->Bahnhofquai/HB 3 min - the 9 min/7 min figures in the task's verified list were not reproduced today.

Lies along the SOUTH facade of the station building, ~40-85 m from the Querhalle south end (platform 3 head).

Bahnhofbrücke (OSM highway=tertiary, bridge, layer=1): ways 53275979 (4 nodes, 47.376935,8.543127 -> 47.376989,8.542301; 63 m), 580414174 (47.3768865,8.5423272 -> 47.3768453,8.5428091) and 8143580 (47.3768453,8.5428091 -> 47.3767882,8.5431533). Bridge deck ~65-70 m; Central tram platform F/H to bridge east end 31-39 m; bridge west end to Bahnhofquai/HB stop node 86 m; total Central F -> Bahnhofquai/HB stop 187 m.

Station building (OSM relation 5708936, outer way 31824193): lon 8.53888-8.54142 (~192 m E-W), lat 47.37714-47.37874; east facade at lon ~8.5412-8.5414 facing Bahnhofquai/Bahnhofbrücke. Haupthalle east portal: covered indoor footway 445003247 -> link 595798550 -> Bahnhofquai sidewalk; portal node 267348654 (47.377759, 8.541364), outer link node 3927253107 (47.377752, 8.541433); 25-30 m from the Bahnhofquai/HB tram stop node. Additional level-0 entrances: NE corner 'Ausgang Landesmuseum' area with stairs 31893468 (top 47.378699,8.541246) and 88438880 (top 47.378781,8.540787) down to level -1; south side entrance=main node 356297795 (47.377320, 8.540074); Nordtrakt covered passage area 492505575 (level 0, lon 8.5398-8.5412, lat 47.3781-47.3785).

facts.claim: Level structure (OSM level tags vs SBB/wiki): 0 = Haupthalle/Querhalle/platforms 3-18; -1 = ShopVille 'Zwischengeschoss' (rel 6619159, centre 47.377944,8.540046; Halle Bahnhofplatz 4.7 m deep) and Passage Sihlquai (rel 17459087, centre 47.378975,8.536497); -2 = Halle Landesmuseum (rel 5829489, 47.378739,8.539614; 7.3 m deep), Plaza (rel 6605180, 47.378007,8.539886), Passage Löwenstrasse (rel 5829490, 47.378074,8.538936), Passage Gessnerallee (rel 5832476, 47.378397,8.538324), Passage Bahnhofstrasse (rel 6605179, 47.377955,8.540440), SZU tracks; -3 = Museumstrasse platforms + Halle Sihlpost (rel 5916360, 47.378783,8.535661); -4 = Löwenstrasse platforms.

Distance table method: sum of haversine legs between OSM nodes listed above (script zh_chains.py). Outdoor legs follow real OSM footway/road nodes; inside the Haupthalle/Querhalle OSM has no routable ways, so the leg east portal -> platform head is a straight line (real path likely +5-10 %). A Dijkstra over the full OSM pedestrian graph (2923 walkable ways, 9078 nodes) reproduces the outdoor legs (e.g. Central H -> Bahnhofquai/HB -> outside-the-building -> platform 3 head = 392 m) but detours around the unmapped hall, so chained values are preferred.

Central F -> head of surface platforms: 402 m (pl. 3), 385 m (8/9), 382 m (10/11), 390 m (18); Central H 375 m and Central B 385 m to pl. 10/11; straight line Central F -> head 10/11 = 360 m. Zero level changes (Bahnhofbrücke, Bahnhofquai, portal, Haupthalle, Querhalle and platforms are all at street level).

Central F -> Museumstrasse 41-44: 424 m via portal -> Haupthalle north escalators (0 -> -2, 19 m) -> Halle Landesmuseum 36 m -> escalator (-2 -> -3, 7 m), landing ~144 m from the platforms' east end / ~268 m from the west end; alternative 438 m via Bahnhofquai north 121 m -> NE-corner stairs (0->-1) -> 49 m -> steps (-1->-2) -> 56 m -> escalator (-2->-3) landing 72 m from the east end. From Bahnhofquai/HB stop: 237 m / 251 m.
facts.source: zh_chains.py; SBB Innenplan page 2 shows 41|42/43|44 access markers at the east end near Ausgang Landesmuseum/Bahnhofquai

facts.claim: Central F -> Löwenstrasse 31-34: 423 m via portal -> Haupthalle central escalators (103 m in, 0 -> -2, 15 m) -> Passage Löwenstrasse west 70 m -> stairs/escalator (-2 -> -4, 50 steps, 18 m), landing ~103 m from the platforms' east end (mid-east). From Bahnhofquai/HB stop: 235 m. Total descent 15.4 m in 2 flights.

Central F -> SZU 21/22: ~423 m via portal -> Haupthalle central escalators (0 -> -1) -> ShopVille south 80 m -> escalator (-1 -> -2, 8 m) to the SZU island platform under the south facade; from Bahnhofquai/HB stop ~236 m; from Bahnhofplatz/HB only 64 m (stairs 31824550 + escalator).

facts.claim: Bahnhofplatz/HB -> platform heads (level 0, via Querhalle south end / 'Ausgang Bahnhofplatz'): pl. 3 40 m (Dijkstra, from west end of tram platform) to 83 m (from east end of tram platform); pl. 10/11 +69 m (110-150 m); pl. 18 +135 m (175-217 m). Bahnhofplatz/HB -> 41-44: 244 m (2 descents); -> 31-34: 199 m (2 descents; or elevator 394113571 0->-4 at 47.377831,8.539261).

Sihlquai/HB -> 41-44 WEST end: 100 m (stairs 0->-1 15 m + escalator -1->-3 20 m), landing ~86 m from the platforms' west end (~330 m from the east end); -> 31-34: 205 m via Passage Sihlquai (2 descents; lands mid-platform ~240 m from the west end); -> platform 10/11 via Passage Sihlquai: 114 m (down 15 m, up 7 m) arriving ~210 m west of the platform head (sector C); -> platform 18 head at level 0 along the platform's north edge: 237 m (straight 193 m).

Along-platform extra to a train door on 3-18: usable platform 420 m (OSM outline 428-453 m), sectors A-D ~105 m each with A at the Querhalle. Zürich HB is a terminus, so an arriving train's front stops at the buffer stop next to the Querhalle and its rear car is in sector A: nearest door typically 10-30 m from the head for any train length; a chosen car/class can be up to ~400 m (IC2000/Giruno full length). If a short train were parked up-platform instead (not verified), the extra would be 100-320 m. Underground: 41-44 mid access lands ~144 m from the east end (2-unit S-Bahn ~200 m centred -> 0-100 m extra), east-end access 72 m; 31-34 access ~103 m from the east end (0-150 m extra).
facts.confidence: medium (sector geometry) / low (stopping practice not verified online)

facts.claim: SBB/transport.opendata.ch walk budgets queried 2026-09-13 for 2026-09-14 08:05: Central -> Zürich HB WALK 4 min (08:05->08:09); Bahnhofplatz/HB -> Zürich HB 1 min; Bahnhofstrasse/HB (8591067) -> Zürich HB 2 min; Sihlquai/HB -> Zürich HB 1 min; Central -> Bahnhofquai/HB WALK 3 min (or bus 46, 1 min). Scheduled tram Central -> Bahnhofplatz/HB 2 min (T3 08:07-08:09, T6 08:11-08:13, T10 08:12-08:14); Central -> Bahnhofstrasse/HB 2-3 min (T7 08:05-08:07, T4 08:07-08:09).

SBB Innenplan Zürich HB (company.sbb.ch, 12/2025) confirms: Erdgeschoss with platforms 3-18 (sectors A nearest the Querhalle, then B, C, D westwards), Haupthalle, Nordtrakt ('Umbau Nordtrakt', 'Provisorium bis voraussichtlich Herbst 2026'), Südtrakt, Ausgang Bahnhofquai (SE/east), Ausgang Landesmuseum (NE), Ausgang Bahnhofplatz and Ausgang Bahnhofstrasse (south), Ausgang Löwenstrasse, Ausgang Gessnerallee, Ausgang Sihlquai (north), Ausgang Europaallee (west); Zwischengeschoss with Halle Landesmuseum, Halle Löwenstrasse, Halle Bahnhofplatz, Passage Sihlquai/Gessnerallee/Löwenstrasse/Bahnhofstrasse, Bahnhof Museumstrasse 41-44, Bahnhof Löwenstrasse 31-34, Bahnhof SZU 21-22 ('Projekt Ausbau Zürich HB SZU bis Dezember 2026', 'neuer Zugang bis Frühling 2026'). Interactive version: plans.trafimage.ch/zuerich-hb.

Where the Bahnhofquai entrance lets you into the hall relative to platforms 3-18: the east portal (47.37776, 8.54136) is at the EAST end of the 131 m Haupthalle, i.e. the far end from the platforms; the platform heads/Querhalle lie 165-185 m to the west-south-west (pl. 3 head 184 m, pl. 10/11 165 m, pl. 18 172 m from the portal). The portal is roughly aligned with platforms 6-9; platform 3's head is 18 m south of that line and platform 18's head 107 m north. Alternative for platforms 12-18: enter at the NE corner (Ausgang Landesmuseum) and use the Nordtrakt passage along the north side of the Haupthalle.

uncertainties: Haupthalle/Querhalle interiors are not mapped as routable OSM ways; the portal->platform-head leg is a straight line (real path likely 5-10 % longer, e.g. detouring around the hall's kiosks/escalator wells).

Level-change counts come from OSM 'level' tags; the central Haupthalle escalators are tagged '0;-1;-2' (ambiguous whether one flight reaches -2); OSM level -1 vs -2 (ShopVille vs Halle Landesmuseum) differ by ~2.6 m per de.wikipedia depths (4.7 m vs 7.3 m).

SZU platforms 21/22 are not tagged in OSM; their position is inferred from SZU rail ways (level -2) ending near lon 8.5410 under the south facade and from the SBB plan; the 'neuer Zugang' (spring 2026) and 'Ausbau Zürich HB SZU bis Dezember 2026' works may change access paths.
Whether short trains on terminus platforms 3-18 stop at the buffer end (rear car in sector A) is inference from Kopfbahnhof practice; no SBB source verified this online.

Bahnhofquai/HB tram stop closure: SBB plan dated 12/2025 says until mid-December 2026; live stationboard 2026-09-13 shows only bus 46 (consistent). Whether 'Umbau Nordtrakt' affects the surface east portal is unknown.

OSM shows tram 15 relations 'Tiefenbrunnen -> Central' and 'Bahnhofstrasse/HB -> Tiefenbrunnen' (asymmetric); the live board at Central showed T15 only toward Tiefenbrunnen, so whether line 15 currently continues from Central to HB is unclear.

transport.opendata.ch today returned Central -> Zürich HB as a 4-min walk and Bahnhofquai/HB -> HB as 3-min-equivalent, not the 9/7 min in the task's verified list; the earlier figures may have come from transfer-walk sections of longer connections or a different day/API path - re-verify before relying on either.

Overpass shared-scratchpad hazard: a sibling agent overwrote research/routes.json with Basel data mid-run; all Zürich artefacts were re-fetched into research/zh/ with zh_ prefixes (zh_routes.json verified to contain Zürich relations).

The Bahnhofstrasse/HB tram platform ways are not connected to the OSM footway graph (Dijkstra 'unreachable'); its distances were not tabulated (SBB walk budget 2 min; stop is ~150 m south of the Querhalle south end).
